# Pranay Suyash

> Product leader and hands-on systems builder for document-heavy workflows, operational AI systems, and internal tools.

Canonical site: https://pranaysuyash.com
Last evidence review: 2026-07-16

## Professional identity

- Primary promise: turns document-heavy, exception-heavy workflows into AI systems people can review and run.
- Core value: starts with files, handoffs, decisions, failure states, and operator consequences; keeps product judgment, interface, architecture, and implementation close enough to produce a usable system.
- Working style: asks for real artefacts and constraints early; separates fact, inference, and unresolved risk; takes delivery through error states, documentation, release gates, and handoff.
- Current context: Co-Founder / Head of Product & Platforms at MedPiper (YC S20), Bengaluru, India.
- Range beyond the primary wedge: local-first desktop products and spatial simulation systems remain audited evidence of broader product and engineering range.

## Work modes

- Senior internal role: sustained ownership across product direction, platform choices, cross-functional execution, and what the organisation learns after launch.
- Bounded commercial engagement: a defined document workflow, operational AI system, subsystem, correction, or decision with explicit scope, delivery evidence, and an end condition.
- Commercial contracting: separate project and advisory terms may be handled through PSRS Technologies Private Limited where applicable; the personal site remains the identity and proof-of-work surface.

## Audited product case studies

- SignKit: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/sig-ext-fastapi
  - Maturity: commercial product
  - Boundary: local signature-image extraction, cleanup, and PDF placement; not certified e-signature verification
- MetaExtract: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/metaextract
  - Maturity: working product build
  - Boundary: metadata coverage, provenance, review and export; field count is not verified correctness
- SentinelTwin: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/sentineltwin
  - Maturity: active platform build
  - Boundary: deterministic coverage and path reasoning before AI explanation
- EchoPanel: https://pranaysuyash.com/work/echopanel
  - Maturity: working prototype
  - Boundary: local capture, transcription and retrieval direction; system-audio setup and production packaging remain active work

## Evidence rules

- Production, commercial, active-build, and prototype states are not interchangeable.
- Workflow diagrams are labelled as diagrams, not product screenshots.
- Direct product screenshots and recordings require local files, revision binding, redaction review, and explicit approval.
- Source, tests, runbooks, architecture records, and independent public records are linked where available.
- Testimonials, customer identities, logos, adoption metrics, and certification claims are omitted without exact-wording permission and evidence registration.
- The workflow library recommends deterministic next paths in-browser and exposes direct starter files; it does not collect behavioral history or send choices to a model.
- The working systems lab executes narrow browser-contained mechanisms using synthetic/default inputs and local browser APIs; it is not presented as the complete flagship products.
- The Three.js spatial explainer remains illustrative progressive enhancement, and standard HTML case studies remain the source of truth for product maturity and shipped capability.
